path.description: Path to the file (relative to workspace or absolute)

sheet.description: XLSX/ODS: sheet name or 0-based index (default: first sheet). Lists all sheet names in metadata when omitted.

pages.description: PDF only: page range, e.g. "1-5" or "10"

start_row.description: XLSX/CSV: first data row to read (1-based, default: 1)

limit.description: XLSX/CSV: maximum rows to return (default: 2000, max: 5000)
